slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

calling instead of texting

call instead of texting once a day. hearing your own voice handle a real conversation is training most people quietly stopped doing.

phoneless lines

wait in every line this week without touching your phone. standing there with nothing to do, and being totally fine, is the most underrated calm there is.

tuesday outfits

wear your favourite outfit on a random tuesday for no reason. saving the best version of yourself for special occasions teaches you that normal days don't deserve it.

morning curiosity

every morning, look up one thing you've always wondered about: why the sky is blue, who built the pyramids, how memory works. curious people never run out of things to say.

mistakes out loud

admit one small mistake out loud every week before anyone catches it. owning it first takes all the power out of being wrong.
